purpose: Visual guide for the next session that wraps puzzle cubes around mission landmark GLBs.

geometry.silhouette: rounded cube with flat face centers
geometry.preferredColorStyle: bright solid colors, one main color per cube

faceMarks.freeFace: small white arrow pointing outward from the cube
faceMarks.oppositeFace: small white or pale oval marker
faceMarks.otherFaces: no mark or a subtle continuation mark, keep face readable

layoutForNextSession.doNotEditMissionGlb: Place the landmark inside the cube field; preserve its source GLB as the target reference.
